My recommendation

Best deal: Soundcore Space One at $80 with code AFSC20, subject to checkout confirmation.

Best for frequent flights: Soundcore Space Q45 for its noise isolation and long battery life.

Best for comfort: Sony WH-CH720N if low weight is your priority.

One thing to keep in mind: budget ANC headphones generally do a better job reducing steady low-frequency sounds, such as airplane engines, than eliminating every voice or sudden noise. Actual noise cancellation performance varies by model and fit. RTINGS' budget headphone testing provides further context.
